operational-example.copy: Select helps people narrow operational data without losing context. Show label, value, helper copy, source freshness, and recovery path.

fields.helper: Applies to KPI, chart, and table

scenario.rationaleTitle: Why this is a Select case
rationale: Options come from remote operational data and can be stale, loading, or permission-filtered.
Changing value updates dashboard filters, URL state, analytics, and table queries.
Keyboard and screen reader users need label, active option, selected value, and listbox state.
